# Luxembourg and Trier, 18 October 2026

The country border is Natural Earth's public-domain 1:50m Luxembourg polygon, retrieved 18 October 2026 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson . Select the feature with ADM0_A3 equal to LUX. License: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ . This overview scale is geographic context, not a navigation map.

The Trier point is the existing map's Hauptmarkt reference, longitude 6.6411602, latitude 49.756765, from OpenStreetMap node 5761430684: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/5761430684 . Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright . The dialog provides both credits with working links. No Luxembourg city is pinned; no route, transport, distance or travel time is claimed.

The editable SVG is 1000x650, north up, using an equal-axis Web Mercator projection: x=475+(longitude−6.1)×440; y=320−(log(tan(π/4+latitude×π/360))−log(tan(π/4+49.8×π/360)))×180/π×440. Border coordinates are rounded to 0.1 output pixel. The colours use the approved pink-primary V23 palette.

The delivered WebP is the complete 1000x650 SVG rendered in Chromium with Source Sans 3 and encoded at quality 92, without a crop. The font is Google Fonts' Source Sans 3 variable TTF, available under SIL OFL, from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/sourcesans3/SourceSans3%5Bwght%5D.ttf . Existing Source Sans 3 font and license records remain in the adjacent fonts directory. Download records and the original geographic feature are retained outside the publication in /workspace/scratch/v24-map.

This replaces the central-Trier map only in the current main reader. Earlier city map assets remain historical sources. The four-day plan comes from the owner; actual photographs, souvenirs and personal anecdotes remain empty until supplied.
